Inside the blend

What's in Perform, and why it's there.

Five botanicals, traditionally used to support libido, stamina, energy and healthy circulation. Tap an ingredient to see what it is and what research says about it.

One Perform capsule350 mg herbal blend

Epimedium

Also called horny goat weed

125 mg36% of each capsule

A leafy herb used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries as a men's vitality tonic. Its best-known compound, icariin, has been studied in the lab for how it interacts with nitric oxide signaling and PDE5, the enzyme pathway involved in healthy blood flow.

Research: Lab and animal researchSource: Review of icariin research, Translational Andrology and Urology

Muira Puama

Ptychopetalum olacoides, the Amazon's “potency wood”

110 mg31% of each capsule

A traditional Brazilian tonic bark, listed in the 1956 Brazilian Pharmacopeia and used for generations to support men's libido and vitality. Small early human studies have looked at it for sexual desire.

Research: Small human studiesSource: Muira puama monograph, Drugs.com

Korean Red Ginseng

Steamed Panax ginseng root extract

50 mg14% of each capsule

One of the most studied herbs in the world, traditionally used for energy, stamina and vitality. It has been tested in a number of clinical trials on men's sexual wellness, with mixed results.

Research: Clinical trials, mixed resultsSource: Cochrane review of ginseng trials, 2021

Rehmannia Root

Prepared (boiled) Rehmannia glutinosa

35 mg10% of each capsule

A staple restorative root in traditional Chinese medicine, steamed before use and traditionally paired with other tonic herbs to nourish and restore.

Research: Traditional useSource: Zhang et al., Journal of Ethnopharmacology, 2008

Tongkat Ali

Eurycoma longifolia root

30 mg9% of each capsule

A Southeast Asian root traditionally used as a men's tonic. A 2022 meta-analysis of clinical trials found it improved total testosterone levels in men.

Research: Clinical trialsSource: Leisegang et al., Medicina, 2022 (meta-analysis)

Research describes each ingredient on its own, often at different amounts than in one Perform capsule. It doesn't describe Perform itself. These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

The backup: what the FDA found in Rhino pills

In November 2018 the FDA warned consumers to avoid Rhino male enhancement products sold at gas stations, convenience stores and online. The agency had identified more than 25 Rhino-branded products since 2007 containing undeclared drug ingredients, some including sildenafil and tadalafil, the active ingredients in Viagra and Cialis.

The FDA reported risks including:

  • Chest pain, severe headaches and prolonged erections
  • Extreme drops in blood pressure leading to hospitalization and surgery
  • Dangerous interactions with nitrate medications used for heart conditions

Source: FDA press release, Nov. 27, 2018

Privacy

Privacy policy

Last updated November 18, 2026

Who we are

This site is operated by Perform Supplements Group, a DBA of Crownbiz Commerce LLC, 600 South Spring Street, Suite 1905, Los Angeles, CA 90014. Questions about this policy: info.crownbizcommerce@gmail.com.

What we collect

  • Order details. When you check out, our payment processor Stripe collects your name, email, phone, shipping address and payment card. We receive your order, contact and shipping details so we can ship and support your order. We never see or store your full card number.
  • Messages. If you use our contact form, we keep your name, email, topic, order number and message so we can reply.
  • Site usage. We use Google Analytics, and may use the Meta Pixel, to understand how visitors use the site and how our ads perform. These tools use cookies and collect information such as pages viewed, items added to cart, purchases, device and browser type, and approximate location.

How we use it

To process and ship orders, answer questions, prevent fraud, improve the site and measure our advertising. We do not sell your personal information.

Who we share it with

Service providers that help us run the store: Stripe (payments), our shipping carriers (delivery), Cloudflare (hosting), Google (analytics) and Meta (ad measurement). Each handles data under its own privacy terms. We may also disclose information when required by law.

Your choices

  • You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, or opt out of Google Analytics with Google's browser add-on.
  • You can manage ad preferences in your Meta account settings.
  • California residents may ask what personal information we hold about them, ask us to correct or delete it, and opt out of any sharing for targeted advertising. Email us and we will respond within 45 days. We will not treat you differently for making a request.

Age

Our products are for adults 18 and older. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18.

Changes

If we change this policy we will update the date above.
